brief: 简约、高级、单色、留白；用户偏好最后两款：03 合声、04 拾点。
stage: Logo 概念图，供选择与继续细化。

concepts.name: 声隙
concepts.subtitle: 一条留白，表达声音
concepts.desc: 圆形中切出一道起伏的留白，以最少的元素表达声音。
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Design a genuinely refined, minimal brand mark for 行商听音助手, a local desktop sound recognition utility for merchant loot in a tactical game.
Art direction: quiet contemporary identity design, precise Swiss graphic sensibility, distinctive understated geometry and exceptional optical proportion. One visual idea only. Think a carefully designed brand symbol, not a collection of literal app pictograms.
Presentation: ONE small-to-medium black #181A1B symbol centered on a completely flat warm-white #F5F4F0 square canvas. The mark occupies approximately 38 percent of canvas width, with very generous white space. One color only. No typography, numbering, labels, layout panels, or mockups.
Finish: mathematically clean edges, consistent considered thickness, generous negative space; clean two-dimensional vector appearance. No texture, no gradient, no shadow, no lighting, no embossing, no 3D, no thin hairlines. No characters, earphones, sound bars, boxes of loot, colored diamonds, shields, or extra decorations. Keep the shape legible at 24px. Deliver a singular memorable logo with restrained confident proportions.
The mark is a pure solid black disc, divided into exactly two balanced pieces by one continuous white negative-space slit. The slit traverses the disc horizontally, rising through one elegant soft angular step at its center, like a single restrained sound pulse; not a sine wave, not a heart monitor. Slit width is 9 percent of disc diameter and its endpoints cleanly meet the circle perimeter. The top and bottom components fit perfectly together across the intentional gap. No inner holes, rings, extra cuts, dots or ornaments. The circle contour stays perfectly circular. Make the single shift in the slit subtle and deliberate, with optical balance rather than mechanical clutter. The result should feel timeless, quiet, precise and identifiable.

concepts.name: 回折
concepts.subtitle: 一道回折，暗示聆听
concepts.desc: 连续线条向内回折，保留听觉的联想，造型轻巧克制。

Design a single continuous broad black ribbon that gently folds inward once, suggesting a listening ear only at a second glance. Start with an upright elongated open arch with a rounded top; its right side descends and curls inward into one short rising inner terminal, while the left terminal stops higher to make the composition deliberately asymmetric. Maximum two turns, never a dense spiral. The silhouette is slender and compact with a subtle forward motion; overall height is about 1.3 times its width. Consistent medium-bold ribbon width, terminals cut cleanly flat, outer curves exact and smooth. A sophisticated abstract acoustic monogram with lots of open air inside it. No anatomical detail, no object inside the ear, no dot, no separate pieces or outer frame.

Create a compact black geometric monogram from exactly TWO opposed L-shaped solid modules. One module sits upper-left and the other lower-right, rotated 180 degrees relative to it. Their facing inner edges are each cut at a single exact 45-degree bevel, creating one broad connected zigzag of white negative space through the center. The overall silhouette is a nearly square compact form with two open opposing corners; it must not be two separate slashes, the letter Z, an infinity loop, a chain link or a pause icon. Use deliberate spacing so the two modules read as a single designed mark with a quiet sound-like rhythm. Two generous solid shapes, no thin outlines, no extra cuts, no tiny details. Slightly soften only the most exposed outer corners while keeping the negative space incisive.

Create an original minimal capture/recognition mark made of exactly TWO elements: a three-quarter black rounded-square contour with its upper-right quarter absent, and one small solid black square placed in that opening. The contour is a single clean continuous C-like squared path, not circular; the empty center is generous. The small square is aligned to the outer contour geometry but separated from both ends by a deliberate gap, like a uniquely detected object entering the outline. It must read as one composed symbol, not an app window, external-link arrow, power switch or QR scanner. Contour thickness about 13 percent of total mark width, small square about 22 percent of width, restrained equal corner radii. Optically balance the square and contour. No arrows, dots, extra corners or decoration.
